relationships.subject: chronic migraine
relationships.evidence_quote: The protein level of endogenous CGRP was significantly increased after CM compared to saline group

key_findings: CGRP, CLR and RAMP1 were upregulated in the vestibular nucleus of NTG chronic migraine rats, with receptor components mainly in neurons.
CGRP1 receptor blockade with BIBN4096BS or PKC inhibition reversed allodynia, vestibular dysfunction, synaptic protein overexpression and PKC/ERK/CREB signalling.
